    Controller bindings

    Left stick to lean. RT to accelerate, LT to brake. RB shifts up and LB shifts down in manual.

    Brake before the bend. Lean in, then roll on the throttle as the road opens.

    A light brush can unsettle the bike. Hard impacts cause a slide and automatic recovery; the clock keeps running.
